fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML section.story-section since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, /rss feed) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-html or S2-rss; 'none' on failures).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/deck, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from direct-child

tags of section.story-section (ld+json has no articleBody on this site).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), extracted from <a href="/author/..."> links on the page. Absent (null) on unsigned/editorial pieces.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from the ld+json publisher object -- always "The Kathmandu Post".

category.title: Category
category.description: Section name taken from the article URL's first path segment (e.g. "national", "world", "money", "opinion") -- ld+json carries no BreadcrumbList on this site.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: Raw upstream publish-date string as shown on the page (e.g. "August 25, 2026") -- no machine-parseable ISO date is available upstream.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: Raw upstream last-updated string as shown on the page (e.g. "August 25, 2026 20:48").

location.title: Location
location.description: Dateline city shown on the page (e.g. "Kathmandu"), when present.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object from ld+json (article mode).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
